run_cli_with_config: run the fairchem CLI with a YAML config file using the -c flag
canonicalize_omegaconf_config: canonicalize an OmegaConf DictConfig by resolving variables and filtering to allowed top-level keys
load_hydra_config_from_yaml: load a Hydra configuration from a YAML file with optional override arguments
launch_job_on_slurm: launch a fairchem job on a SLURM cluster with optional Ray support
launch_job_locally: launch a fairchem job locally with optional Ray cluster or torch elastic mode
